left_envelope.inclusion_envelope: R&D-performing units and R&D resources whose subject-matter content belongs to FORD 2.1 Civil engineering within Engineering and technology.
left_envelope.exclusion_envelope: Civil-engineering construction, repair, operation, manufacturing, project execution, or professional service activity merely concerning civil-engineering objects when it is not R&D subject-matter content classified under FORD 2.1.
left_envelope.evidence_rationale: Frascati Manual 2015 Chapter 2.6 defines FORD as a content-based classification of R&D knowledge domains and Table 2.2 places Civil engineering at FORD 2.1 under Engineering and technology.
left_envelope.uncertainty: The permitted FORD material does not provide a lower-level 2.1 breakdown here; that limits internal granularity but not the classification object as R&D subject-matter content.

right_envelope.inclusion_envelope: General construction of civil-engineering objects, including new work, repair, additions, alterations, on-site prefabricated or temporary objects, and the road, railway, utility, industrial, water, and other heavy-construction activities specified in ISIC groups 421, 422, and 429.
right_envelope.exclusion_envelope: Building construction classified in division 41, specialised construction activities classified in division 43, and architectural, engineering-design, and construction-project-management activities classified in 711 are outside ISIC division 42.
right_envelope.evidence_rationale: ISIC Rev.5 Section F and Division 42 define an economic-activity envelope centered on construction of civil-engineering objects; classes 4210, 4220, and 4290 specify included construction and explicit exclusions.
right_envelope.uncertainty: The official explanatory notes establish the Division 42 activity boundary for this adjudication; they do not determine later Domain overlap, non-duplication, or eligibility.

adjudications.rationale: FORD 2.1 classifies the R&D knowledge-domain content of civil engineering, while ISIC 42 classifies construction activity performed on civil-engineering objects. Construction, repair, and project execution are material activity scope, not a removable source-frame wrapper; the inclusion and exclusion envelopes are therefore not equivalent.
adjudications.uncertainty: This normalization-specific negative coextensiveness decision does not establish no overlap, no relationship, final non-duplication, final Domain separation, or eligibility.

left_envelope.inclusion_envelope: R&D-performing units and R&D resources whose subject-matter content belongs to FORD 5.3 Education within Social sciences, provided the activity satisfies the Frascati R&D criteria.
left_envelope.exclusion_envelope: Routine teaching, education, and training that do not satisfy the R&D criteria are outside the FORD R&D-content envelope, including ordinary higher-education teaching and training distinguished from R&D in Chapter 9.
left_envelope.evidence_rationale: Frascati Manual 2015 Chapter 2.6 and Table 2.2 classify Education as FORD 5.3 R&D subject matter; Chapters 2 and 9 distinguish R&D from routine education and training.
left_envelope.uncertainty: The permitted FORD material does not provide a lower-level 5.3 breakdown here; that limits internal granularity but clearly retains the R&D-content boundary.

right_envelope.inclusion_envelope: Education provision at any level or for any profession, including formal and non-formal programmes, instruction, qualifying education, self-employed instruction, and administration, inspection, operation, intermediation, or support covered by ISIC groups 851 through 856.
right_envelope.exclusion_envelope: Activities assigned outside Section Q include child day-care at ISIC 8890; research and experimental development on social sciences and humanities is assigned to ISIC 7220 rather than Division 85.
right_envelope.evidence_rationale: ISIC Rev.5 Section Q and Division 85 define an economic-activity envelope for education provision and support across groups 851-856, with explicit exclusions including R&D classified in 7220.
right_envelope.uncertainty: The official explanatory notes establish the Division 85 activity boundary for this adjudication; they do not determine later Domain overlap, non-duplication, or eligibility.

adjudications.rationale: FORD 5.3 classifies R&D subject-matter content concerning education, while ISIC 85 classifies provision, instruction, administration, intermediation, and support of education. ISIC expressly places relevant R&D outside Division 85, so the activity difference is material rather than a removable frame lens.
adjudications.uncertainty: This normalization-specific negative coextensiveness decision does not establish no overlap, no relationship, final non-duplication, final Domain separation, or eligibility.

rationale: Both Pass 2A deferred pairs are closed as not coextensive for normalization because official same-classification clarification establishes materially different R&D-content and economic-activity envelopes. The existing Pass 2A singleton partition therefore requires no grouping revision.
uncertainty: Candidate materialization is only structurally permitted for a later governed task. No candidate is created here, and singleton status still does not establish non-overlap, final non-duplication, Domain separation, or eligibility.
